name: tidia
displayName: Tidia — dictation cleanup for Claude Code
description: Tidy dictation for AI: turns voice dictation in the Claude Code prompt into a clear, concise message before you send it, with fillers, repeats and taken-back words gone and several requests as a list; or, in minimal style, keeps your own wording.

style.title: Style
style.description: polish: a clear, concise message for the AI; one point as plain sentences, several requests as a list, and your output rules (wording, register such as polite or casual, layout). minimal: plain sentences in your own words, only fillers and taken-back words removed; output rules are not applied.

english_terms.title: English terms
english_terms.description: How far English and technical terms that speech recognition wrote phonetically go back to English spelling. auto: by the dictation's language (high for Korean, Japanese, Russian and other phonetic scripts, low for Chinese and for Latin-script languages other than English, off for English). off: never. low: code (useEffect, git push). medium: also product, company and language names (Claude, Python). high: also technical words (database, commit).

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that cleans the dictated text. sonnet: most faithful (default). haiku: fastest and cheapest, may drop a request after a spoken correction. opus: most capable, slowest.

learn.title: Learn corrected words
learn.description: ask: when you retype a dictated word the same way twice, add it to the dictionary. off: never learn.

dict_approval.title: Dictionary changes by Claude
dict_approval.description: auto: Claude adds a word you dictated that speech recognition got wrong (when the two sound alike), and removes entries it added, without asking; each change is shown. Changing or removing any other entry (yours, or one Tidia learned from your corrections) asks. ask: every dictionary change Claude makes asks you first.

polish_on.title: When to tidy
polish_on.description: enter: tidy once, when you press Enter (fewest model calls; the send waits a few seconds; message_view sets how the message then shows). pause: tidy each time you stop speaking and show the result above the prompt, so you see what Enter sends; a model call per pause (often 2–4 per message), and the preview cannot be edited: change the prompt and it is sent as you changed it, untidied.

message_view.title: Tidied message view
message_view.description: How a message tidied at Enter shows in the conversation, on the desktop and in the terminal. tidied: only the message sent. labeled: what Tidia did above it (→ tidied, → list, → minimal). full: what you said, then what Tidia did and the message sent.

bubble_labels.title: Bubble words
bubble_labels.description: The words for what Tidia did, shown with message_view labeled or full, in the order tidied/list/minimal, separated by /. A part left empty keeps the interface language's word. Up to 80 characters.

debug.title: Show details
debug.description: Show what Tidia does: the tidied preview, the rule and setting changes Claude made, and why a send went out untidied. Off: Tidia stays quiet, except for the dictionary changes Claude makes and Claude turning Tidia on or off, which always show.

dictionary.title: Use the dictionary
dictionary.description: Send your dictionary entries and the conversation's file and identifier names to the cleanup as spelling hints, and learn words you correct. Off: tidy without them (your entries are kept).

attach_raw.title: Attach the raw transcript
attach_raw.description: Send the raw dictation with each tidied message as one line Claude sees and your message row does not, so Claude can recover from a bad cleanup. The line holds a fixed sentence and the raw text only.

ui_language.title: Interface language
ui_language.description: Language of the mod's labels: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Hindi or Indonesian. auto follows Claude Code's language setting; unsupported languages use English.
